name: secrets_scan
description: Find key-like strings in text with rules modelled on gitleaks' default configuration: AWS access key ids and secret keys, GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Stripe, Google API and npm tokens, Slack webhooks, private-key PEM headers, JWTs and generic high-entropy values assigned to key, token, secret or password names (Shannon entropy threshold). Every match is redacted to its first 4 characters and reported with rule, file, line, column and entropy. Text inline or relative files.

paths.description: Relative paths inside the working directory

entropy_threshold.description: Bits per character for the generic rule

include_examples.description: Keep matches that look like documented placeholders (EXAMPLE, xxxx, fake)

catalog.source: Rules adapted from gitleaks' default config/gitleaks.toml (Zachary Rice, MIT); Shannon entropy as in gitleaks' generic-api-key rule
